title: Signed divider under output backpressure
hypothesis: One arithmetic RTL module. Signed remainder rules must coexist with a stalled result handshake.
why_hard: Initial hypothesis is preserved in the original broad-bank snapshot. Screening: The divider uses live sign in result correction rather than storing it with operands; ready/valid input stability and exceptional division cases are not settled.
next_action: Specify when sign may change, then simulate output stalls and signed corner cases against a mathematical quotient/remainder oracle.
